title: Meetings
import-failed: Couldn't import that recording. Use an m4a, mp3, wav, ogg, webm or mp4 file.
load-failed: Couldn't load your meetings. Try again in a moment.
empty-description: Record a meeting on this computer, or import a recording. Recordings and notes stay on this computer.
typed-note-placeholder: Type a note and press Enter
no-typed-notes: No notes typed during this meeting.
consent-message: Let everyone know you're recording. In some places the law requires everyone's consent.
consent-local: Eigent records your microphone. The recording and notes stay on this computer.
problem-denied: Eigent can't use the microphone. Allow it in your system's privacy settings, then try again.
problem-no-device: No microphone was found. Connect one and try again.
problem-busy: The microphone is in use by another app or couldn't start. Close the other app and try again.
problem-unsupported: Recording isn't available here. You can still import a recording.
problem-unknown: The microphone couldn't start. Try again.
problem-device-lost: The microphone was disconnected. Eigent saved what was recorded.
problem-start-failed: The recording couldn't start. Try again.
problem-save-failed: The recording couldn't be saved. Your typed notes were kept.
not-found: This meeting was deleted or can't be found.
interrupted-explanation: This recording stopped unexpectedly. What was saved before it stopped is kept.
note-help: Write the summary, decisions, action items and open questions. Writing the note for you comes in a later version.
save-failed: Couldn't save the change. Try again.
add-to-space-description: Eigent copies the note into the Space's Meetings folder as a Markdown file, so Sessions in that Space can use it.
no-spaces: You don't have a Space yet.
add-to-space-failed: Couldn't add the note to the Space. Try again.
space-has-no-folder: This Space has no folder on this computer yet.
changed-since-added: Changed since it was added to {{space}}
remove-from-space-hint: The file stays in the Space.
removed-from-space: Removed. The file stays in the Space.
replace-copy-title: Replace the file in the Space?
replace-copy-message: The note's file in {{space}} was changed there. Replacing it loses those changes.
delete-message: Its recording and notes are removed from this computer.
delete-message-with-copies: Its recording and notes are removed from this computer. Copies already added to Spaces stay.
delete-failed: Couldn't delete the meeting. Try again.
close-recording-quit-message: A meeting is being recorded. Eigent saves the recording so far, then quits.
close-recording-window-message: A meeting is being recorded in this window. Eigent saves the recording so far, then closes the window.
